Cp и Cv, число степеней свободы, теплоём: Cp and Cv, number of degrees of freedom, heat capacity in an arbitrary process.
E=hν, p=E/c, поглощение и испускание фот: E=hν, p=E/c, absorption and emission of a photon, conservation laws for the photon.
P = σST⁴, равновесная температура тела п: P = σST⁴, equilibrium temperature of a body under irradiation, cooling by radiation.
Q = ΔU + A: связь теплоты, работы и изме: Q = ΔU + A: relation between heat, work, and change in internal energy.
ln y от ln x для определения показателя: ln y vs ln x to determine the power exponent; ln y vs x for the exponential exponent.
{#0} тем теоретического тура — по томам: {#0} theoretical round topics — by volumes and chapters of "Physics for the Curious" by A. I. Slabadzianiuk — and {#1} entries in the separate experimental round glossary: setup, apparatus, methods, uncertainties, graphs, presentation.
«Как измерить сопротивление с помощью се: "How to measure resistance with a stopwatch?" — the instrument is used unconventionally to measure a quantity not directly accessible.
«Точечные» характеристики вещества, сред: "Point" characteristics of matter, average density, mixtures and inhomogeneous bodies.
Ёмкость уединённого проводника и конденс: Capacitance of an isolated conductor and a capacitor; parallel-plate, spherical, and cylindrical capacitors.
Амплитуда, период, частота и фаза; перио: Amplitude, period, frequency, and phase; periodic functions and the equation x = A·cos(ωt + φ).
Аппроксимация прямой и извлечение её пар: Linear fit and extraction of its parameters
Баланс подводимого и отводимого потока (: Balance of incoming and outgoing flux (of heat, charge, substance, momentum) in steady state — a general approach for problems in heat conduction, circuits, outflow, and diffusion.
Векторная диаграмма, сложение сонаправле: Vector diagram, addition of collinear and perpendicular oscillations, beats, Lissajous figures.
Вертикальные броски и падение в поле тяж: Vertical throws and free fall in a gravitational field without air resistance.
Взаимодействие точечных зарядов, системы: Interaction of point charges, systems of charges, equilibrium in the field of several charges.
Вид функции заранее не известен: его уга: The form of the function is not known in advance: it is guessed from the graph, checked by power or exponential linearization, and justified. Also includes cases where linearization is impossible and features of the curve are studied — maxima, minima, asymptotes, inflection points.
Вместо единичного измерения снимается фу: Instead of a single measurement, a functional dependence is obtained: more precise, tests theory, and is rated higher.
Внутренняя энергия идеального и многоато: Internal energy of an ideal and polyatomic gas, dependence on temperature.
Вогнутое и выпуклое зеркало, фокус, форм: Concave and convex mirror, focus, mirror formula, magnification.
Вольтамперная, нагрузочная или входная х: Volt-ampere, load, or input characteristic of an element as the main measurement result.
Восстановление вида зависимости из разме: Restoring the form of a dependence from dimensions, estimates via similarity and scaling.
Восстановление параметров модели или скр: Restoring model parameters or a hidden scheme from response data — 'black box', calibration, optical or electrical identification of a system; connects theory and experiment.
Вращение твёрдого тела вокруг оси, момен: Rotation of a rigid body about an axis, torque, equation of rotational motion.
Второй закон в проекциях, третий закон,: Second law in projections, third law, analysis of forces acting on a body.
Выбор осей и вида линеаризации с учётом: Choosing axes and the type of linearization, taking into account how the uncertainties of individual points are distributed on the graph, so that mechanical application of least squares does not shift the final slope.
Выбор осей и регрессии по погрешностям: Choosing axes and regression by uncertainties
Выбор схемы измерений до их проведения:: Choosing the measurement scheme before conducting them: which quantities to measure, in what range, with what step and accuracy.
Вывод законов отражения и преломления из: Derivation of the laws of reflection and refraction from the principle of least time.
Вывод работы: согласие с теорией в преде: Conclusion of the work: agreement with theory within uncertainty, qualitative agreement or refutation of the model, analysis of discrepancies; checking the value predicted by the formula by measurement.
Выводы: сравнение эксперимента с теорией: Conclusions: comparison of experiment and theory
Выделение теплоты в проводнике, мощность: Heat generated in a conductor, electric power, electric heaters.
Выталкивающая сила, условия плавания, пл: Buoyant force, conditions for floating, density and draft.
Вытеснение поля из сверхпроводника, сохр: Expulsion of field from a superconductor, conservation of flux through a superconducting loop.
Гармоническая волна на струне, длина вол: Harmonic wave on a string, wavelength, speed, wavenumber, phase.
Гидродинамика течения по трубам, распред: Hydrodynamics of flow in pipes, pressure distribution along a pipe. Includes viscous flow (Poiseuille's formula) as a special case.
Гидрокинематика: линии тока, расход, ура: Hydrokinematics: streamlines, flow rate, continuity equation.
Гидростатическое взвешивание, плотность,: Hydrostatic weighing, density, floating bodies, Cartesian diver.
Давление в движущейся жидкости, истечени: Pressure in moving fluids, outflow from an orifice, lift force.
Давление в покоящейся жидкости, гидроста: Pressure in a stationary fluid, hydrostatic paradox, hydraulic press, pistons.
Давление насыщенного пара, относительная: Saturated vapor pressure, relative humidity, dew point, evaporation and condensation.
Давление света на зеркальную и чёрную по: Pressure of light on a mirror and a black surface, light sail.
Два вида зарядов, закон сохранения заряд: Two types of charge, law of charge conservation, elementary charge, volume charge density.
Движение заряда в магнитном поле: Motion of a charge in a magnetic field
Движение по произвольной кривой: тангенц: Motion along an arbitrary curve: tangential and normal acceleration, radius of curvature.
Движение с постоянной скоростью по прямо: Motion with constant velocity in a straight line: distance, speed, time, meetings and pursuits.
Движение тела переменной массы, уравнени: Motion of a body with variable mass, Meshchersky equation and Tsiolkovsky formula.
Движение тела, брошенного под углом: дал: Motion of a body thrown at an angle: range, height, reachable area, reflections.
Действующие значения тока и напряжения,: RMS values of current and voltage, average power on a resistor.
Длина свободного пробега, диффузия газов: Mean free path, gas diffusion, Brownian motion as a random walk.
Жидкостные манометры, насыщенный пар, из: Liquid manometers, saturated vapor, isothermal and adiabatic processes, 'weighing air'.
Зависимость сопротивления от геометрии и: Dependence of resistance on geometry and material, temperature coefficient, resistance of the medium.
Заземление проводника, экранирование, по: Grounding a conductor, shielding, field inside a cavity, redistribution of charge when connected to ground.
Закон Био–Савара–Лапласа. Расчёт поля то: Biot–Savart–Laplace law. Calculation of current fields
Закон Гука и его границы, изгиб линейки,: Hooke's law and its limits, bending a ruler, rubber band, plasticity.
Закон Ома для участка цепи и в дифференц: Ohm's law for a circuit segment and in differential form.
Закон Ома и его границы, соединения пров: Ohm's law and its limits, combinations of conductors, nonlinear elements, charging a capacitor.
Закон Фурье, остывание, плавление льда,: Fourier's law, cooling, melting of ice, specific heat capacity and heat of phase transitions.
Закон Фурье, тепловой поток через стенку: Fourier's law, heat flow through a wall, series and parallel thermal resistances.
Закон всемирного тяготения, поле тяжести: Law of universal gravitation, gravitational field, gravitational interaction of bodies and shells. Includes gradient of the gravitational field and tidal effects as a facet.
Закон отражения, мнимое изображение в пл: Law of reflection, virtual image in a plane mirror, mirror systems.
Законы Бойля–Мариотта, Шарля и Гей-Люсса: Boyle–Mariotte, Charles, and Gay-Lussac laws; isothermal, isochoric, and isobaric processes, graphs.
Законы сохранения в ядерной реакции, пор: Conservation laws in nuclear reactions, threshold energy, fission and fusion. Also: Decay and scattering of particles.
Замена заряда вблизи проводника (или ино: Replacing a charge near a conductor (or other boundary) with a fictitious "image" source that gives the same boundary condition—a rare but medal-worthy opening move.
Замена переменных X(x), Y(y) без неизвес: Substitution of variables X(x), Y(y) without unknown parameters, transforming the theoretical curve into a straight line.
Запись окончательного ответа: различение: Recording the final answer: distinguishing between absolute and relative error (in percent "for style"), significant figures and rounding — error to one significant digit, value to the same decimal place. Percent, absolute error, and rounding are stages of a single action; almost no one searches for collections by them separately.
Зарядка и разрядка конденсатора через ре: Charging and discharging a capacitor through a resistor, current rise in a coil, characteristic times.
Затухание под действием сухого и вязкого: Damping due to dry and viscous friction, logarithmic decrement, quality factor.
Звуковые волны, скорость звука, резонанс: Sound waves, speed of sound, resonance in pipes, frequency change due to source motion.
ИЗМЕРЯЕМЫЙ объект — ЭДС и внутреннее соп: MEASURED object — EMF and internal resistance of a source: galvanic cell, battery, motor-generator, induction as a source of EMF. If the source only powers the circuit, use pribor_istochnik_pitaniya instead of this sheet.
Идеальный цикл Карно, максимальный КПД,: Ideal Carnot cycle, maximum efficiency, comparison of real cycles with the ideal one.
Извлечение ответа из графика: площадь по: Extracting the answer from a graph: area under the curve, slope, intersection point of characteristics. Includes plotting a graph (scale, axes, error bars) as part of this skill, not as a separate sheet (cross-file merge with former postroenie_grafika).
Извлечение физических величин из геометр: Extracting physical quantities from the geometry of a photo, scan, or video frame — linking image scale to real sizes and times; a modern and independent experimental technique.
Изготовление измерительного прибора или: Making a measuring instrument or sensor
Излучательная способность, серое тело, р: Emissivity, gray body, equilibrium radiation. Also: Radiative heat exchange.
Излучение и распространение электромагни: Emission and propagation of electromagnetic waves, relation between E and B, transfer of energy and momentum.
Измерение s(t): скатывание, падение, мая: Measuring s(t): rolling, falling, Maxwell's pendulum, brachistochrone; checking for uniform acceleration.
Измерение давления, в том числе жидкостн: Pressure measurement, including with a liquid manometer "if you don't have mercury".
Измерение малых размеров с ценой деления: Measurement of small dimensions with a vernier scale division of {#0} / {#1} mm.
Измерение периода по совпадению фаз двух: Measuring the period by phase coincidence of two oscillations — accuracy is higher than with direct counting.
Измерение силы; часто заменяется калибро: Force measurement; often replaced by a calibrated spring or rubber band.
Измерения по фотографии, скану и видеока: Measurements from photo, scan, and video frame
Изображение колебаний на фазовой плоскос: Representation of oscillations in phase space; reading motion from a phase portrait.
Импульс тела и системы, импульс силы, за: Momentum of a body and a system, impulse of a force, closed systems, recoil.
Инерциальные системы отсчёта и эквивален: Inertial reference frames and equivalence of motion description in them.
Интерференция в тонком слое, потеря полу: Interference in a thin film, half-wave loss, fringes of equal thickness and equal inclination.
Использование симметрии системы для сокр: Using system symmetry to simplify calculation: equal currents, zero fields, equivalent nodes.
Источник названий и структуры: А. И. Сло: Source of names and structure: A. I. Slabadzianiuk, "Physics for the Curious" and "Physics {#0}"; experimental dictionary — "Physics Olympiad: Experimental Round". {0}
Источник питания как ОБОРУДОВАНИЕ устано: Power supply as EQUIPMENT in the setup: LIP, {#0} V battery, accumulator — it powers the circuit, while something else is measured. If the EMF and r themselves are measured, use obekt_istochniki_toka.
Источник с внутренним сопротивлением, ре: Source with internal resistance, matching modes, maximum power transfer.
Источник узкого пучка для оптических изм: Source of a narrow beam for optical measurements: refraction, diffraction, interference.
Источники тока, ЭДС и внутреннее сопроти: Current sources, EMF and internal resistance
Итоговая погрешность одной прямо измерен: Final error of a single directly measured quantity: instrument component (accuracy class, scale division), random scatter of repeated readings, and their quadratic combination into the total error. Often combined in one problem ({#0}-third-exp-{#1}-{#2}, {#3}-final-exp-{#4}-{#5})—one skill with three facet values, not three leaves.
Качение без проскальзывания, мгновенный: Rolling without slipping, instantaneous center of velocity, relation of velocities of points of a body.
Когерентность, оптическая разность хода,: Coherence, optical path difference, conditions for maxima and minima.
Колебания груза на пружине, соединения п: Oscillations of a mass on a spring, combinations of springs, effect of spring mass.
Колебания твёрдого тела вокруг оси, прив: Oscillations of a rigid body about an axis, reduced length, reversible pendulum.
Колебания, не сводящиеся к одной синусои: Oscillations not reducible to a single sine: harmonic decomposition, anharmonicity, dependence of period on amplitude.
Круговые и эллиптические орбиты, энергия: Circular and elliptical orbits, energy and angular momentum in orbit. Also: Satellites and orbital maneuvers.
Лабораторные весы с разновесами или элек: Laboratory balance with weights or electronic scales; often replaced by a lever or spring.
Лампочки, диоды, терморезисторы: графиче: Bulbs, diodes, thermistors: graphical solution using the current-voltage characteristic.
Линеаризация (приведение зависимости к л: Linearization (reducing a dependence to linear form)
Магнетики: поле в веществе, типы магнети: Magnetic materials: field in matter, types of magnetics
Магнитные взаимодействия, вектор индукци: Magnetic interactions, the induction vector as a field characteristic, pattern of field lines.
Магнитный момент и энергия магнитного ди: Magnetic moment and energy of a magnetic dipole
Магнитный момент контура или тела и энер: Magnetic moment of a loop or body and the energy of its interaction with an external field — torque, orientation, potential energy of a dipole; training camp and IZhO level skill.
Малые колебания нитяного маятника, завис: Small oscillations of a simple pendulum, dependence of period on length and g, anharmonic regime.
Мгновенная и средняя мощность, КПД механ: Instantaneous and average power, efficiency of a mechanism, engine power and thrust.
Металлическая, деревянная или пластмассо: Metal, wooden, or plastic ruler; maximum error {#0}-{#1} mm by class.
Механические волны: динамика, волновое у: Mechanical waves: dynamics, wave equation, energy
Механический или электронный секундомер;: Mechanical or electronic stopwatch; experimenter's reaction as a source of random error.
Механическое действие магнитного поля на: Mechanical action of a magnetic field on currents and shells, magnetic pressure.
Микроскоп, телескоп, лупа, бинокль, прое: Microscope, telescope, magnifier, binoculars, projector, camera, eye: magnification, angular resolution, ray paths in the system.
Модель идеального газа, вывод основного: Ideal gas model, derivation of the basic equation of kinetic theory, molecular-kinetic meaning of temperature.
Модуль Юнга, деформации растяжения, сдви: Young's modulus, tensile, shear, and bending deformations, strength limit.
Моль, число Авогадро, закон объёмных отн: Mole, Avogadro's number, law of combining volumes, partial pressures in a gas mixture.
Момент импульса точки и тела, условия со: Angular momentum of a point and a body, conservation conditions, problems on rotating systems.
Нагрузка и обратное влияние прибора: Loading and back-action of the instrument
Намагниченность, магнитная проницаемость: Magnetization, magnetic permeability, dia-, para-, and ferromagnetics, permanent magnets.
Напряжённость поля точечного заряда, сло: Field strength of a point charge, superposition of fields, field lines.
Неидеальность установки: диагностика и п: Non-ideality of the setup: diagnosis and correction
Неучтённый побочный фактор и поправка на: Unaccounted side factor and correction for it: internal resistance of voltmeter and ammeter, friction, heat exchange with the environment, buoyant force of air, mass of the thread. Each correction must be justified.
Нормальная реакция опоры, натяжение нити: Normal reaction force, tension in a string, conditions for a body to leave a surface.
Обратная задача: восстановить модель по: Inverse problem: reconstruct the model from the response
Одноразовый шприц для дозирования объёма: Disposable syringe for dosing volume, creating pressure, and studying gas processes.
Опорожнение сосуда через отверстие, клеп: Emptying a vessel through an orifice, clepsydra, Poiseuille's law, filtration.
Определение вида зависимости и обработка: Determining the type of dependence and processing a nonlinear graph
Определение момента, когда исходный зако: Determining the moment when the original law or formula ceases to apply (breakaway, saturation, regime change, disappearance of a root), and switching to a piecewise solution.
Определение схемы и параметров скрытой ц: Determining the circuit and parameters of a hidden circuit only by external measurements ("yellow box", "red box").
Оптическая сила, формула шлифовщика, изм: Optical power, optician's formula, measurement of focal length.
Остатки и отклонение от модели: Residuals and deviation from the model
Отдельное измерение фонового или паразит: Separate measurement of background or parasitic effect (heat loss, own friction, stray light) and its subtraction from the main result, instead of trying to correct everything with a single error.
Отдельный словарь: не тема задачи, а тех: Separate dictionary: not a problem topic, but a measurement technique, instrument, error analysis, or graphing. Used together with the theoretical round topic.
Отклонение луча призмой, угол наименьшег: Deviation of a ray by a prism, angle of minimum deviation, dispersion into a spectrum, rainbow.
Отражение волны от границы и от закреплё: Reflection of a wave from a boundary and from a fixed end, refraction at the interface of media.
Оформление работы на листах ответов: наз: Formatting the work on answer sheets: title and aim, setup diagram, labeled result tables with units, processing, final answer. Used when the statement requires filling in a table, providing a diagram, or formatting results. Mandatory formatting checklist (table, axes, units, result, conclusion), not a separately trained skill — method set to false after teardown review.
Оценка производной по дискретным экспери: Estimating the derivative from discrete experimental points (finite differences: symmetric or stable integral form) instead of analytical differentiation of a known function.
Оценки размера и энергии основного состо: Estimating the size and energy of the ground state from Δx·Δp ≳ ħ.
Оценочные задачи: разумные допущения, от: Estimation problems: reasonable assumptions, discarding small terms, checking plausibility of the answer. Unites theoretical and experimental order-of-magnitude estimation (cross-file merge).
Первая и вторая космические скорости, эн: First and second cosmic velocities, energy approach to launch.
Переменная масса и открытые механические: Variable mass and open mechanical systems
Перемещение, скорость и ускорение как ве: Displacement, velocity, and acceleration as vectors; decomposition by axes, hodograph.
Перенос одной и той же математической ст: Transferring the same mathematical structure of a solution between different physical systems: heat conduction, electric circuits, diffusion, mechanical relaxation.
Перенос погрешностей через расчётную фор: Propagation of errors through a calculation formula: for products of powers, relative errors are added with weights; rules for operations with approximate numbers; danger of subtracting close values.
Переход между системами отсчёта, сложени: Transition between reference frames, addition of velocities, motion on a river and in wind.
Переходы между уровнями, возбуждение уда: Transitions between levels, excitation by collision, spectral series.
Плавное изменение тока и напряжения; рео: Smooth adjustment of current and voltage; rheostat as a divider and as an object for calibration.
Плоское движение по окружности, движение: Planar circular motion, motion along a helical path, motion in crossed fields.
Плотность энергии поля, энергия взаимоде: Energy density of the field, energy of interaction of charges, energy of a charged sphere and plates.
Подгонка прямой Y = aX + b к эксперимент: Fitting a straight line Y = aX + b to experimental points and estimating its parameters: least squares method (using means, variances, and covariance) OR the two boundary lines "by eye" method. Also includes Δa and Δb, the conclusion "the dependence is directly proportional because Δb > b", and the correlation coefficient. The MOST COMMON processing sheet: always used when the slope or intercept is found from a set of points, even if the word "least squares" is not written, but it says "draw a straight line and find its slope".
Подъём в капилляре, форма и объём капли,: Capillary rise, shape and volume of a drop, wetting, soap films.
Поиск экстремума физической величины по: Finding the extremum of a physical quantity with respect to a system parameter — which representation of the problem to choose before taking the derivative; unites cross-topic extremal problems.
Показатель преломления, преломление на п: Refractive index, refraction at a plane boundary, ray path through a plate. Also: Refraction at small angles.
Показатель преломления, фокусное расстоя: Refractive index, focal length, interference and diffraction, absorption and scattering of light.
Поле и энергия диполя, диполь во внешнем: Field and energy of a dipole, dipole in an external field, torque on a dipole.
Поле прямого и кругового тока, суперпози: Field of a straight and circular current, superposition of fields from a system of conductors.
Полная механическая энергия и её сохране: Total mechanical energy and its conservation; energy transformation between forms.
Положение и движение центра масс, систем: Position and motion of the center of mass, center-of-mass frame as a convenient reference system.
Полярные и неполярные диэлектрики, элект: Polar and nonpolar dielectrics, electrets, field in a dielectric, dielectric permittivity.
Поперечная разность потенциалов в провод: Transverse potential difference in a conductor with current in a magnetic field — determination of the sign and concentration of charge carriers.
Последовательное и параллельное соединен: Series and parallel connections, calculation of complex capacitor arrays.
Последовательное построение, эквивалентн: Sequential construction, equivalent optical power, telescopic path. Also: Lens and plane-parallel plate; Lens and mirror.
Постоянные (керамические, неодимовые) ма: Permanent (ceramic, neodymium) magnets and coils: induction experiments, "magnetic viscosity" of a falling magnet in a tube, field measurement, interaction of magnets, electromagnet.
Построение изображений собирающей и расс: Image construction by converging and diverging lenses, principal rays. Also: Lens and liquid; Velocity and longitudinal magnification of the image.
Постулаты Бора, радиусы и энергии уровне: Bohr postulates, radii and energy levels, Bohr–Sommerfeld quantization.
Постулаты, преобразования Лоренца, замед: Postulates, Lorentz transformations, time dilation, length contraction, velocity addition.
Потенциал и разность потенциалов, напряж: Potential and potential difference, voltage, equipotentials, relation E = −dφ/dx, work of the field in moving a charge. Always included when the solution involves potential or voltage as a characteristic of the FIELD (not just voltage across a circuit element).
Потенциальная энергия в поле тяжести, де: Potential energy in a gravitational field, stretched spring, and gravitational attraction.
Потери механической энергии на трение; з: Mechanical energy losses due to friction; dependence of friction work on path.
Поток вектора индукции, теорема о магнит: Flux of the induction vector, magnetic flux theorem, flux linkage of a loop.
Правила узлов и контуров, метод наложени: Node and loop rules, superposition method, equivalent source.
Предельный угол, световоды, ход луча в п: Critical angle, optical fibers, ray path in a total internal reflection prism.
Пренебрежение временами установления по: Neglecting establishment times compared to the characteristic time of the problem: current, field, or flow are assumed to adjust instantly to current conditions.
Приведение нескольких серий с разными на: Reducing several series with different initial conditions to a single universal dependence by a suitable choice of dimensionless variables.
Приведение произвольной системы к гармон: Reduction of an arbitrary system to a harmonic oscillator by potential energy; autonomous and dissipative systems, oscillations of liquid in a tube.
Прикладные системы: циклотрон, масс-спек: Applied systems: cyclotron, mass spectrometry, deflection systems, cathode-ray tube, magnetron.
Применение первого закона к изохорному,: Application of the first law to isochoric, isobaric, and isothermal processes.
Принцип Гюйгенса–Френеля, зоны Френеля,: Huygens–Fresnel principle, Fresnel zones, diffraction at a slit and circular aperture.
Принцип работы тепловой машины, расчёт К: Principle of operation of a heat engine, calculation of efficiency for an arbitrary cycle, refrigerator and heat pump.
Проверка отклонений экспериментальных то: Checking deviations of experimental points from the model line or curve as an independent source of information, not just noise — a high correlation coefficient does not prove the model.
Проверка прямого и обратного хода характ: Testing direct and reverse characteristic: the result depends on the sample's history, not just current conditions; incompatible points cannot be mixed in one characteristic.
Продольные и поперечные волны на упругой: Longitudinal and transverse waves in an elastic chain and in a solid, wave speed via elastic moduli.
Пружины и их соединения, растяжение стер: Springs and their combinations, stretching rods, Hooke's law.
Прямое измерение объёма жидкости; мензур: Direct measurement of liquid volume; class-{#0} cylinders give {#1} cm³ maximum error.
Прямое измерение углов — отклонения маят: Direct measurement of angles — pendulum deflection, angles of incidence and refraction, plane tilt.
Прямолинейное распространение света, тен: Rectilinear propagation of light, shadow and penumbra, ray tracing.
Работа газа A = ∫p dV, площадь под графи: Work of a gas A = ∫p dV, area under the process curve in p–V coordinates, work in isoprocesses and in a cycle.
Работа силы, теорема о кинетической энер: Work of a force, kinetic energy theorem, work of a variable force as area.
Равновесие зарядов на проводнике, индуци: Equilibrium of charges on a conductor, induced charges, field inside and near the surface.
Равновесие тела и системы тел: сумма сил: Equilibrium of a body and a system of bodies: the sum of forces and the sum of moments are zero; lever, ladder, rope.
Равномерное вращение точки: период, угло: Uniform rotation of a point: period, angular velocity, centripetal acceleration.
Равноускоренное движение по прямой и в п: Uniformly accelerated motion in a straight line and in space: formulas for distance and velocity, braking.
Разбиение неоднородного тела или поля на: Dividing an inhomogeneous body or field into thin layers/elements with a local law and subsequent summation or integration — a technique for inhomogeneous rods, conductors, heat conduction, and distributed masses.
Разделы повторяют тома и Части/Главы Сло: Sections follow the volumes and Parts/Chapters of Slabadzianiuk; leaves are his subsections.
Различение силы тяжести и веса, перегруз: Distinguishing weight and gravitational force, overload and weightlessness.
Различение средней путевой скорости, сре: Distinguishing average speed along the path, average velocity, and instantaneous velocity.
Разложение по малому параметру и удержан: Expansion in a small parameter and keeping the leading term — turns a nonlinear problem into a linear one near a known solution; distinguishes a meaningful approximation from an unjustified 'neglect'.
Разложение сложного движения на простые: Decomposition of complex motion into simple components; linearity of kinematic equations.
Распознавание симметрии распределения за: Recognizing symmetry in charge distributions (plane, sphere, ring, system of plates) and choosing between Gauss's theorem and direct summation of fields of symmetric bodies—in real solutions this is a single step, not two.
Распределение давления с высотой, изотер: Pressure distribution with height, isothermal and adiabatic atmosphere, balloon.
Распределение молекул по скоростям и эне: Distribution of molecules by speeds and energies, mean speed and mean square, fluctuations.
Раствор с электродами как источник ЭДС и: A solution with electrodes as a source of EMF and a nonlinear element: electrode polarization and electrolysis alter the current-voltage characteristic of the cell — it cannot be described by a single Ohm's law.
Расчёт момента инерции тел, теорема Штей: Calculation of moment of inertia of bodies, Steiner’s theorem, rotational kinetic energy.
Расчёт полей по симметрии (теорема Гаусс: Calculation of fields by symmetry (Gauss's theorem)
Расчёт токов и напряжений в цепи с источ: Calculation of currents and voltages in a circuit with a source, short circuit, efficiency of a source.
Расширение диапазона прибора: Extending the range of an instrument
Релятивистские энергия и импульс, E=mc²,: Relativistic energy and momentum, E=mc², reaction threshold.
Сам измерительный прибор изменяет измеря: The measuring instrument itself alters the measured quantity (voltmeter loading, thermal inertia of a thermometer)—accounting for this effect in the physical model, not just in the error budget.
Самоподобие бесконечной цепочки, рекурре: Self-similarity of an infinite chain, recurrence relations for repeating elements.
Сборка оптической схемы с обязательным у: Assembly of an optical setup with mandatory ray tracing; measurement of focal length.
Сборка установки и обязательная схема в: Assembly of the setup and mandatory schematic in the report: circuit diagram, ray path in optics, mounting on a stand, relative arrangement of parts.
Свободные и вынужденные колебания в LC-к: Free and forced oscillations in an LC circuit, analogy with a mechanical oscillator.
Связь скоростей и ускорений разных тел ч: Relation of velocities and accelerations of different bodies through geometric constraints — strings, pulleys, pistons, rolling, and other rigid mechanisms; the main step to take before writing Newton’s second law, and it carries over between pulleys, mechanisms, fluids, and rolling.
Свёртка активного двухполюсника к источн: Reducing an active two-terminal network to an EMF source with internal resistance.
Свёртка резистивной цепи любой сложности: Reduction of any resistive circuit: series-parallel transformations, use of symmetry, bridge circuits, and Kirchhoff's rules when reduction is impossible. The boundary between "simple" and "complex" circuits is subjective—one parent skill with facets, not two separate leaves.
Сила на движущийся заряд в магнитном пол: Force on a moving charge in a magnetic field; comparison of electric and magnetic forces.
Сила на проводник с током в магнитном по: Force on a current-carrying conductor in a magnetic field, interaction of parallel currents, current loop.
Сила поверхностного натяжения, формула Л: Surface tension force, Laplace formula, wetting, capillary rise.
Сила сопротивления, пропорциональная ско: Drag force proportional to velocity or its square; terminal velocity.
Сила тока, плотность тока, связь с конце: Current, current density, relation to carrier concentration and drift velocity.
Силы инерции, центробежная сила, сила Ко: Inertial forces, centrifugal force, Coriolis force; transition to a rotating frame.
Система отсчёта и закон движения; восста: Reference frame and law of motion; reconstructing x(t) from given v(t) or a(t) — “the main problem of kinematics” according to Slabadzianiuk.
Системы с «отрицательным трением», маятн: Systems with 'negative friction', pendulum clocks, maintenance of undamped oscillations.

Словарь тем БелФО: {#0} тем теоретическо: BelPhO topic glossary: {#0} theoretical round topics by Slabadzianiuk's volumes and {#1} experimental glossary entries — setup, apparatus, methods, uncertainties, graphs, presentation.
Сложение волн от двух и нескольких точеч: Superposition of waves from two or more point sources, conditions for maxima and minima.
Смешивание тел разной температуры, калор: Mixing bodies of different temperatures, calorimeter, accounting for vessel heat capacity and losses.
Снятие характеристики прибора (ВАХ, нагр: Measuring the characteristic of an instrument (I-V, load)
Сопротивление воздуха и жидкости, вязкос: Air and liquid resistance, viscosity, sliding and rolling friction, stagnation phenomenon.
Сопротивления в цепи переменного тока (а: Resistances in an AC circuit (resistive, capacitive, inductive)
Составление и решение уравнений движения: Setting up and solving equations of motion, recognizing the equation of harmonic oscillations.
Способ получения величины: непосредствен: Method of obtaining a value: directly from the instrument scale (direct), by calculation from other measured quantities using a formula (indirect), or as a systematic series of repetitions for averaging. Facet, not an independent training skill—the educational value lies in specific methods (calibration, inverse problem, graph slope, null method).
Стеклянный жидкостный термометр или терм: Glass liquid thermometer or thermocouple / thermistor with calibration.
Стоячая волна как результат наложения вс: Standing wave as a result of superposition of counter-propagating waves, nodes and antinodes, normal modes.
Температура как параметр равновесия, кол: Temperature as an equilibrium parameter, quantity of heat, specific heat capacity of a substance.
Теорема о циркуляции вектора B; поле сол: Theorem on the circulation of vector B; field of a solenoid, toroid, long wire, and current sheet.
Тепловые измерения: теплоёмкость, теплот: Thermal measurements: heat capacity, heat of dissolution and melting, losses to the environment.
Теплопередача как способ изменения внутр: Heat transfer as a way to change internal energy; heat exchange with the environment, cooling of bodies.
Термодинамическое описание процессов с п: Thermodynamic description of processes with an arbitrary p(V) equation, polytropic process.
Тип измерения: прямое, косвенное, серия: Type of measurement: direct, indirect, series
Трение покоя и скольжения, коэффициент т: Static and kinetic friction, coefficient of friction, condition for slipping, rolling friction.
Три закона Кеплера, эллиптические орбиты: Kepler's three laws, elliptical orbits, relation between period and major semi-axis.
Упругие и неупругие соударения, лобовые: Elastic and inelastic collisions, head-on and oblique impacts, energy loss in collisions.
Упругий и неупругий удар, коэффициент во: Elastic and inelastic collisions, coefficient of restitution, energy losses — "almost nuclear physics".
Уравнение Эйнштейна, работа выхода, крас: Einstein's equation, work function, threshold frequency, stopping voltage.
Уравнение адиабаты, работа при адиабатич: Adiabatic equation, work during adiabatic compression and expansion.
Уравнение вынужденных колебаний, резонан: Equation of forced oscillations, resonance curve, energy transformations at resonance.
Уравнения Клапейрона и Менделеева–Клапей: Clapeyron and Mendeleev–Clapeyron equations, arbitrary processes on a pV diagram.
Уровни несмешивающихся жидкостей, U-обра: Levels of immiscible liquids, U-shaped tubes, tube with mercury.
Ускорение и отклонение заряженных частиц: Acceleration and deflection of charged particles by a uniform electrostatic field.
Условие главных максимумов, разрешающая: Condition for principal maxima, resolving power, grating spectrum.
Установки на равновесие рычага; взвешива: Lever equilibrium setups; weighing without scales.
Устойчивое и неустойчивое равновесие, ан: Stable and unstable equilibrium, analysis via potential energy.
Устройство и уравнения трансформатора, х: Structure and equations of a transformer, open-circuit, lossless mode, accounting for losses.
Участник сам собирает весы, датчик, тесл: The participant assembles the scales, sensor, teslameter themselves and then calibrates it; measurement starts with construction.
Фазовые переходы первого рода, удельная: First-order phase transitions, specific latent heat of fusion and vaporization.
Формула преломления на одной сферической: Refraction formula at a single spherical surface, general lens formula. Also: Thick lenses.
Формула тонкой линзы, линейное увеличени: Thin lens formula, linear magnification, sign convention, real and virtual images.
Цифровой мультиметр в режимах вольтметра: Digital multimeter in voltmeter, ammeter, and ohmmeter modes; getting to know its ranges is part of the task.
Чёрный ящик: восстановление скрытой сист: Black box: reconstructing a hidden system from its response
Школьные стрелочные приборы; их собствен: School analog instruments; their own resistance and correct connection scheme — a common trick.
Шунт, добавочное сопротивление, делитель: Shunt, additional resistance, voltage divider—converting a school instrument to the required range; extending the range of a multimeter or dynamometer.
ЭДС индукции при изменении магнитного по: Induced EMF due to changing magnetic flux, Lenz's law, eddy currents.
ЭДС на движущемся стержне, перемычка на: EMF on a moving rod, sliding contact on rails, loop entering a field.
Экспериментально построенная связь между: Experimentally established relationship between the measured and sought quantities, when there is no formula for conversion.
Экспериментальное изучение колебаний: за: Experimental study of oscillations: dependence of pendulum period on its parameters, torsional oscillations, beats, damping, reversible pendulum, oscillations of a mass on a spring or rubber band.
Экспоненциальный закон распада, активнос: Exponential decay law, activity, decay chains, dating.
Энергия заряженного конденсатора, потери: Energy of a charged capacitor, losses during charging from an EMF, redistribution of charges, work when changing capacitance.
Энергия тока и магнитного поля, превраще: Energy of current and magnetic field, energy transformations with changing inductance.
Явление самоиндукции, индуктивность конт: Self-induction phenomenon, inductance of a loop and solenoid, current during switching on and off.
Явления переноса: пробег, диффузия, броу: Transport phenomena: mean free path, diffusion, Brownian motion
Явное построение и обоснование расчётной: Explicit construction and justification of a calculation model — which effects are taken into account, which are deliberately neglected and why; the main difference between school-level substitution and olympiad physics.
Ядерные реакции. Дефект масс и энергия с: Nuclear reactions. Mass defect and binding energy
